name: AllStyles
summary: Returns the combined style bit value for every supported text style.

name: Bold
summary: Returns the style bit value used for bold text.

name: DayNameJ
summary: Returns the Japanese weekday name for a date.

name: DoubleUnderline
summary: Returns the style bit value used for double underlining.

name: FieldStyle
summary: Returns field style information supplied by the current design context.
details: The engine delegates this to design metadata; without a host-provided design callback the result is empty, and compatibility with a live host is unverified.
differences: Needs host-provided design metadata; live-host behavior is unverified.

name: HighlightYellow
summary: Returns the style bit value used for yellow highlighting.

name: Hiragana
summary: Converts eligible Japanese text to hiragana.

name: Italic
summary: Returns the style bit value used for italic text.

name: KanaHankaku
summary: Converts eligible kana characters to half-width forms.

name: KanaZenkaku
summary: Converts eligible kana characters to full-width forms.

name: Katakana
summary: Converts eligible Japanese text to katakana.

name: MonthNameJ
summary: Returns the Japanese month label for a date.

name: NumToJText
summary: Formats a number with a selected Japanese digit style and grouping option.

name: Plain
summary: Returns the style bit value that represents unformatted text.

name: RGB
summary: Combines red, green, and blue channel values into one integer color value.

name: RomanHankaku
summary: Converts eligible Roman characters to half-width forms.

name: RomanZenkaku
summary: Converts eligible Roman characters to full-width forms.

name: SmallCaps
summary: Returns the style bit value used for small capitals.

name: Strikethrough
summary: Returns the style bit value used for struck-through text.

name: Subscript
summary: Returns the style bit value used for subscript text.

name: Superscript
summary: Returns the style bit value used for superscript text.

name: TextColor
summary: Applies a numeric RGB color to all characters in text.

name: TextColorRemove
summary: Removes color formatting, optionally only when it matches a given color.
details: Formatting stays in style runs while the text itself remains unchanged; a visible formatting result can be obtained with GetAsCSS.

name: TextFont
summary: Applies a font name to all characters in text.

name: TextFontRemove
summary: Removes font formatting, optionally only for a matching font name.

name: TextFormatRemove
summary: Returns the text without its font, size, color, or style formatting.

name: TextSize
summary: Applies a point size to all characters in text.

name: TextSizeRemove
summary: Removes size formatting, optionally only at a matching size.

name: TextStyleAdd
summary: Adds the selected style bits to every character in text.

name: TextStyleRemove
summary: Removes the selected style bits from every character in text.

name: Underline
summary: Returns the style bit value used for underlining.

name: WordUnderline
summary: Returns the style bit value used for underlining words.
